content: Kaneuyewekani tame temɨyɨwawemete teminewienikɨ titakɨ memɨkateyɨwawe mɨkɨ memɨwerarani. Taxaɨtame xeikɨa temɨnaki'akakɨ tepɨkayɨaka.
Taxexuitɨ tekeyɨaka tahepaɨ tewi pɨta mɨnaki'akakɨ, 'aixɨa mɨ'itɨarienikɨ mɨtseiriyarienikɨ.
Kɨritsitu yuxaɨtame xeikɨa mɨnaki'akakɨ pɨkayɨanekai, matsi kemɨre'uxa: «Nehetsie xeikɨa katininakeni memɨmatsi'aye'unie watierika».
Naitɨ meripaitɨ mɨtiuti'utɨarie, temɨteti'ɨkitɨarienikɨ katiniuti'utɨarieni, para tete'uka'eniwatɨ 'utɨarika xapayari tatsinɨtɨakaku yuri temɨte'eriekakɨ teta'ikwewatɨ.
Mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ mɨtatikupitɨwa temɨte'uka'eniwanikɨ temɨnɨtɨarienikɨ, mɨkɨ kexepitɨaka yaxeikɨa xemɨteyumaikakɨ yunaitɨ, Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi xe'ɨketɨ,
'axeikɨa xeitetayarikɨ xe'utiniutɨ 'aixɨa xemutiyuanenikɨ kemɨ'ane Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu mɨkakaɨyarieya mɨ'ukiyarieya hepaɨtsita.
'Ayumieme xekeneyutanaki'eri yunaitɨ, Kɨritsitu mɨxe'utanaki'eri hepaɨ, Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa mɨtikɨhɨawarɨwanikɨ.

'Ipaɨ nepaine, Kɨritsitu mɨkɨ xitekiya 'inɨariyari memexeiya waparewiwame kanayani, matsiɨkɨme meyeitɨanikɨ yuri kemaine Kakaɨyari, mitatseiriyakɨta meripaitɨ tatutsima kemɨtiwarutahɨawixɨ kename metemikienikekai,
mɨkɨta memɨkahuriyutsixi 'aixɨa memutiyuanenikɨ Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita muwanenimayakɨ, kemɨre'uxa:
Tawari mɨpaɨ paine:
Tawarita:

content.text: Yunaitɨ teɨteri kwikari hetsiena mieme xekeneutikwikani».

content: Tawari Kitsariyaxi mɨpaɨ paine:

Kakaɨyari mɨtiyupitɨwa tita xemɨtetakwewie yuri xete'erietɨ, mɨkɨ kexehɨniyani naimekɨ xemɨyutemamawiekakɨ yu'iyaritsie xemɨka'uximatɨariekakɨ mexi yuri xete'erie, matsi waɨkawa yuri xemɨte'eriekakɨ xeta'ikwewatɨ, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata xetɨrɨkariyakaku.
Papuru, memɨkahuriyutsixi tiwaxaxatɨwame
Neri yuri nepɨti'erie ne'iwama xehepaɨtsita, kename yɨkɨmana xehɨpɨne 'aixɨa xeteyurietɨ, kename naime xetemate, kename xeyɨwawe xemɨyu'imaiyanikɨ.
Hipame xapayaritetsie nekweriwa'anetɨ nepɨtixe'uta'utɨiri, tawari nexehaye'eritɨwatɨ hepaɨtsitana, Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa tiuka'iyaritɨ mɨpaɨ mɨnetiumikɨ,

Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi parewiwameya nemayanikɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi wahetsiemieme, mawari wewiwame hepaɨ neti'uximayatɨ Kakaɨyari niukieya 'aixɨa manuyɨne hetsiemieme, mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi mawari memakɨnekɨ memɨtanaki'eriwakɨ, Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme memɨpatsienikɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata yatiwapatakaku.
Hikɨtsɨri Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi hetsie netiwiyatɨ nekaniyɨweni 'aixɨa nemɨtinekɨhɨawenikɨ nehepaɨtsita, tita Kakaɨyari mɨtiyuriene nexatatɨ.

Nepɨma tixaɨtɨ nemɨtikuxatanikɨ, tita Kɨritsitu mɨtiuyuri yanetiyurienekaku ne mɨkɨ xeikɨa nepɨkuxatani. Yanetiyurienekaku, mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi yametekahutɨ mekanakɨne, ne'utaniukakaku meta neti'uximayakaku,

tɨrɨkariya nehexeiyakaku 'inɨarite mamariwawemekɨ mɨtiyɨnikɨ, tɨrɨkariya nehexeiyakaku Kakaɨyari 'Iyarieya hetsɨa miemekɨ. Kerutsareme neheyeyaka 'Iririku paitɨ neheuyeyuneka nekanaye'ani yemekɨ netikuxatatɨ niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne Kɨritsitu hepaɨtsita,
'ipaɨ netinemexɨitɨatɨ, niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne nemukuxatanikɨ hakewa kemɨ'ane Kɨritsitu mɨhɨkɨ mɨkahetaxatsiewetsie xeikɨa, kapa ne xeime tenarieya heima ne'anukiinikɨ.
Matsi mɨpaɨ kemɨre'uxa:
'Ayumieme mɨixa nepukunuitɨarie nemɨkaxe'iwatamiekɨ.
Papuru kemɨreuyeimɨkɨkai Xuma paitɨ
Hikɨri 'uwa pumaweri hakewa nemɨre'uximayaka. Mɨixa wiyari waɨkawa nepeuyeimɨkɨ nemɨxe'iwatamiekɨ
kepauka 'Itsipaniya nemɨmietsie. Ne'uyemietɨ nepɨxexeiyamiekaku. Xemeta mana xemɨnetsiparewienikɨ nemeta'anikɨ, yapaɨmexɨa 'etsiwa xehetsɨa netemawieritɨarieyu.
Matsi hikɨ Kerutsareme nepɨyemie parewiya newayetuirienike Kakaɨyari teɨterimama.
Matseruniyatari 'akaiyatari mekaniyuwaɨriya 'axeikɨa tixaɨtɨ memɨtewaminikɨ mɨkɨ tixaɨtɨ memɨkateheuxeiya Kakaɨyari teɨterimama Kerutsareme memetitei.

Mɨpaɨ mekateniyuwaɨriyani, kaneuyewekata mɨpaɨ memɨtewarapinirienikɨ. Memɨkahuriyutsixi mɨkɨ wahepaɨ meheixeiyatɨ memakɨkɨ 'Iyaritsie timieme. Peuyewetse mɨkɨtari memɨwaparewienikɨ wawaiyaritsie timieme hepaɨtsita.
'Ayumieme 'ikɨ ne'aye'atɨame, 'ikɨ wa'imikieri newayetuirieme, nekanayeyeimɨkɨ, xehetsɨa nekanekuyeimɨkɨ 'Itsipaniya nemeta'anikɨ.
Xehetsɨa kepauka nemeta'ani, nepɨtimate nemunuani nehɨnetɨ niuki Kɨritsitu hepaɨtsita 'aixɨa manuyɨne hetsie timiemekɨ 'aixɨa xemɨ'itɨarienikɨ.
Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu mɨtati'aitɨwamekɨ, 'Iyari mɨtatsipitɨakɨ temɨtetakanaki'eriekakɨ, mɨpaɨ nekatinixewawirieka ne'iwama, xemɨnetsiparewiekakɨ nenewieri xe'ipitɨatɨ Kakaɨyari nehetsiemieme
nemɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ, Kureya memɨtama yamemɨkatekahu 'axamemɨkanetsiyurienikɨ, 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ memenunakekɨ Kakaɨyari teɨterimama, kenemɨtiwaparewieni Kerutsareme hetsie,
para xehamatɨa nemɨ'uxipiekakɨ kepauka nenetemawietɨ nemeta'ani xehetsɨa, kemɨtinake Kakaɨyari.
Mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari mɨtatsipitɨa ta'iyaritsie temɨka'uximatɨariekakɨ, mɨkɨ ke'uyeikani yunaime xehamatɨa. Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa nepaine.
